title: JRA Graded Races (2002-2025) & JBIS 5-Generation Pedigree Dataset (Bilingual JA/EN + Graph Networks & ML)

creators.name: Mendonça, Arthur De Oliveira
creators.affiliation: Centro Federal de Educação Tecnológica de Minas Gerais (CEFET-MG)

description: Comprehensive relational, graph-ready, and machine-learning-ready dataset of Japanese Thoroughbred horse racing covering 24 years (2002-2025) of Japan Racing Association (JRA) Graded Races (G1, G2, G3) coupled with 5-generation genealogical pedigrees extracted from the Japan Bloodhorse Information System (JBIS). Includes both original Japanese (data/csv/) and 100% hybrid-AI-translated English editions (data/csv_en/), interactive Gephi graph projects and vector PDFs (data/gephi/), and empirical tables for Sports PageRank, Wright's Coefficient of Inbreeding (F_X), K-Means++ PCA stallion archetypes, and zero-leakage Random Forest podium classification (data/analysis/). Contains 3,216 Graded races, 33,409 race entries, 8,209 unique racehorses, 8,202 direct pedigrees, and 504,074 5-generation pedigree tree nodes validated with zero broken foreign keys.
notes: Developed as an integrated project for Data Science and Algorithms & Data Structures II (AEDS 2) at CEFET-MG (Divinópolis Campus).
